mentions.name: sup-xml
mentions.description: A Rust-based XML parser that can be used on its own or as a drop-in replacement for libxml2 at the C ABI level. It is roughly 2x faster than libxml2, and being written in Rust eliminates the class of memory-safety bugs that drive a large share of CVEs.
mentions.problem: Memory-safety bugs cause roughly 70% of CVEs; implementing the parser in Rust rules out that entire class of vulnerabilities at compile time while also outperforming libxml2.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been making a Rust-based XML parser that can be used on its own, or as a drop-in replacement for libxml2 at the C ABI level. Basically, it's not only 2x faster than libxml2, but being written in Rust eliminates a lot of cybersecurity risk.

evidence.value: I've been making a Rust-based XML parser that can be used on its own, or as a drop-in replacement for libxml2 at the C ABI level. Basically, it's not only 2x faster than libxml2, but being written in Rust eliminates a lot of cybersecurity risk.
